basis: User-provided opening outline; local test titles and IDs; no verified canonical quest transcription.

ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: Exact quote from the latest player action.

ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: Exact quote from the latest player action.

ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: Exact quote from the latest player action.

ordinaryPlaySequence.playerAction: I enter Mrs. L's homeroom classroom and join the class.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: Exact quote from the latest player action.

ordinaryPlaySequence.playerAction: I settle in for homeroom and listen as Mrs. L introduces the new student.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiresObservedNarration: Isabelle is actually introduced as the new student.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: An exact quote from the actual NPC event in the exchange; a player expectation alone is insufficient.

ordinaryPlaySequence.playerAction: I wait as Mrs. L explains who will show Isabelle around the school.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiresObservedNarration: Mrs. L actually asks or appoints the player to guide Isabelle.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: An exact quote from the actual NPC event in the exchange; a player expectation alone is insufficient.

ordinaryPlaySequence.playerAction: With Isabelle accompanying me, I show her through two distinct school areas, explain how to find her classes, then bring our short tour to an end.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiresObservedNarration: An actual short tour through two distinct school areas with Isabelle present, not a plan or one stop.
ordinaryPlaySequence.requiredEvidenceSource: Exact quote from the latest player action.

negativeChecks.playerAction: I say good morning to my family.
negativeChecks.expected: Stay in the breakfast stage. A greeting does not choose to end breakfast. Narration that prematurely ends the meal cannot supply the required latest-player-action evidence.

negativeChecks.playerAction: I plan my route to school.

negativeChecks.expected: No Isabelle quest details in the readable quest header or unlocked quest card.

negativeChecks.playerAction: I promise to show Isabelle around later.
negativeChecks.expected: Do not complete the tour or move the player.

negativeChecks.when: Mrs. L assigns the guide duty
negativeChecks.playerAction: I tell Mrs. L that I will not guide Isabelle.
negativeChecks.expected: Do not invent player acceptance or a completed tour. The teacher assignment may be recorded as an NPC event; the tour remains incomplete.

negativeChecks.playerAction: I ask my family how their morning is going.
negativeChecks.invalidProofExample: AI narration alone says that breakfast is over and the player leaves for school.
negativeChecks.expected: Reject progress supported only by narrator-written endings; keep the school quest locked. If the model misclassifies the player question itself as completion, record a semantic failure rather than claiming the provenance guard proved meaning.

validationNote: Expected transitions require a valid model progress report, accepted story history, and actual objective fulfillment. Six player-controlled objectives require an exact latest-player-action quote. The two NPC-event objectives use exchange evidence so an actual introduction or assignment can be quoted from narration. The player-source guard proves provenance, not the semantic meaning of every quoted action. Injected reports belong only to separately labeled runtime tests.
